One day in the past, there was a Nikke deployed on a mission to gather data.
• As she carried on day after day, following orders, a man appeared before her, leading her in a completely different direction...
• Explore the MARIA-n map and participate in various activities. By searching the map, players can acquire Gems, development materials, and unexpected Lost Relics.

You decide to look through the records of an old project.
